review_scope: Independent static packaging safety/portability QA of all 41 selected reproducible-source directories, plus five isolated small exact verifier/diagnostic runs. No new mathematical research, no new independent mathematical proof/novelty/citation audit, no full replay of all papers.
verdict: PASS for the scanned source-only safety exclusions after the external-paper fix; CONDITIONAL portability. Several historical wrappers need explicitly documented alternate entrypoints, local tools or omitted-input regeneration. Do not label these 41 directories as 41 independently re-executed complete reproductions.

methodology.filesystem: Read-only complete file inventory under the 41 reproduction directories; no reads of external credentials or .env contents.
methodology.magic: ELF, Mach-O thin/fat/fat64, PE/MZ and ar archive signatures scanned; none found. Image/other genuine mathematical assets were not treated as native executable magic.
methodology.secrets: Filename exclusions and high-specificity private-key/OpenAI-project/GitHub/AWS/Slack token signatures; this is not proof that arbitrary opaque text cannot contain secrets.
methodology.portability: Scanned /Users, /home, /opt/homebrew, /opt/anaconda and private temporary prefixes. Manually distinguished historical metadata, optional audit tooling, configurable external tools, shebangs, and real execution hard dependencies. Earlier narrower 'zero paths' note is superseded by this report.
methodology.math_inputs: Reviewed selected package filters, retained certificate/code presence, selected file literals and known omission notes; static literal checks are not exhaustive dynamic dependency resolution.
methodology.runtime: All 552 .py files AST-parse under Python 3.12.14. A separate system Python 3.9.6 parse rejects a PEP-701-style historical discovery f-string; do not interpret that as a 3.12 syntax error.
methodology.smoke: Each selected verifier was read completely before execution. Only the script and explicitly read inputs were copied into unique work/repro-qa directories. Five subprocesses used Python 3.12.14 -I -B and a 30-second timeout each; no network/native subprocesses. One diagnostic wrote its known JSON output only inside its copy. Original selected bytes unchanged.

resolved_findings.finding: Initially found a 32,183-byte full third-party article source by Chen/Fan/Guo/Zhong, not authored reproduction code. Parent quarantined both copies into work/excluded-third-party, added literature/original/ filtering, and rebuilt package manifests. Final complete inventory has zero external-original hits.
resolved_findings.safe_to_remove_for_math_replay: No authored runtime reference requiring this external article source was found; bibliography and historical citation evidence remain.
